tomd.py.summary: Convert HTML files to Markdown with readability.
details: Extracts the main article with ``readability``, converts it with ``markdownify`` and writes the ``.md`` next to the source, deleting the original HTML on success. Existing ``.md`` files are left alone and the tree is processed in parallel.

top11.py.summary: Show the largest files below the current directory in a table.
details: Sorts the files by size, truncates the long paths and prints the top ``N`` (11 by default) with their human-readable sizes in aligned columns.

top12.py.summary: Print the ten largest files below the current directory.
details: Walks the tree keeping a heap of the ten biggest files and prints them as ``<bytes> bytes - <path>``, largest first.
Resolves the given path, moves it into ``~/repos`` under the same name and appends a numeric suffix when that name is taken.
Same argument style as :doc:`tolo`: file paths, shell globs and ``-f LISTFILE`` lists, with unique names for the collisions, moved into the personal scripts directory.

trafila.py.summary: Extract the main article of HTML pages as Markdown with trafilatura.
details: Runs ``trafilatura.extract`` in Markdown mode with links, images and tables, falls back to ``html_to_markdown`` on the cleaned soup when nothing is extracted and writes the ``.md`` file next to the source; ``-r`` also removes the original HTML.

translate_code_comments.py.summary: Translate the comments and docstrings of source files to another language.
details: Subcommands: ``scan`` and ``detect`` translate the comments by language detection, ``ast`` the AST-level strings and docstrings, ``japanese`` the Japanese text only and ``batch`` every file. ``--target``/``--source`` set the languages, ``--exclude``/``--marker`` skip the paths and the marked strings, ``--backup``/``--dry-run`` control the writes and long strings are left alone.

translate_noneng_filenames.py.summary: Rename the non-ASCII file and directory names below the current directory to English.
details: Walks the tree bottom-up, translates the stems with Google Translate and renames the entries, adding a numeric suffix when the translation collides with an existing name.

transwords.py.summary: Translate a word list to Persian in parallel and save it as JSON.
details: Splits ``words.txt`` into ~4500-character chunks, translates each chunk with ``deep_translator`` in a process pool and merges the results into ``fa_en.json``, logging the failures.

try_decode.py.summary: Decode a file by trying a long list of encodings.
details: Attempts utf-8/utf-8-sig first, then the common single-byte code pages and the extra exotic ones, and prints the file content once an encoding decodes the first chunk without errors.

trydecomp.py.summary: Detect and extract an archive or compressed file whatever its format.
details: Sniffs the magic bytes, ranks the candidate decoders and tries them in order: libarchive, the stream decompressors (gzip, bz2, lzma, brotli, zstd, lzma, cramjam), tarfile, zipfile, py7zr, rarfile, acefile, cabarchive and pycdlib, with a pickle fallback. Members are written under a safe path.

tscleaner.py.summary: Strip the comments from TypeScript and JavaScript sources with tree-sitter.
details: Picks the grammar per suffix (``.ts``, ``.tsx``, ``.d.ts``, ``.js`` ...), collects the comment nodes, deletes them through atomic writes and processes the source files of the current directory in a pool.

tsrmc.py.summary: Remove the comments from source files of many languages with tree-sitter.
details: Supports Rust, shell, C/C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, HTML and Lua with the matching tree-sitter grammar, preserves the shebangs, the licence headers and the lint directives, can also drop the blank lines and offers ``--diff``, ``--dry-run`` and ``--backup``.

ttf2woff2.py.summary: Convert the TTF/OTF fonts below the current directory to WOFF2.
details: Compresses each font with fontTools' ``woff2`` encoder, gives a unique name when the ``.woff2`` already exists, deletes the source on success and converts the files in parallel.
